title: Bauchbinde_simple
slide_intent: Simplify a speaker label when the background is busy so identifying information remains easy to find.
strategic_value: A restrained white nameplate with a red edge can identify speakers while leaving complex DB footage room to read.
demonstration: A white lower-left nameplate enters and exits with a red wipe or edge, holding a bold name above a smaller description.
practical_value: Choose the simple lower third for complex content or a visually busy background.

content_islands.name: Nameplate reveal
content_islands.spec: Use the red edge to uncover the white plate at the lower left.

content_islands.name: Reading hold
content_islands.spec: Keep the bold name and smaller role visible before the simple exit.
